rationale: The stock is sitting at 90.9% of today's range near the session high with only 25 minutes to close, meaning any position would be liquidated at market regardless of outcome — an unfavorable risk/reward dynamic. The price action shows a strong intraday recovery from $44.73 to $48.47 (well above VWAP at $46.63), but the negative earnings catalyst (massive EPS miss, Strong Sell rating) creates fundamental headwinds that make a long chase at the top of the range risky, while shorting into a momentum surge near the high with limited time is equally unattractive. With existing committed capital and a working order already in place, adding exposure here offers no clear mechanical edge.
